This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the

 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for grant of bail relating to FIR/Crime No.704/2023 dated 13.07.2023 registered at Police Station Chourai, district Chhindwara, for the offences punishable under Sections 376,
376(2)(n) of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The applicant is in judicial custody since 13.07.2023 and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district Chhindwara and there is no likelihood of his absconding or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
The applicant is ready to furnish surety and shall abide by all the directions and conditions imposed upon him by the court.
Upon these circumstances, the applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
The prosecutrix in this case is a major lady who had been in long relationship with the applicant.
They also developed physical relationship.
It is claimed by the prosecutrix that a false promise for marriage was made to her by the applicant.
The statements of prosecutrix recorded under section 164 of Cr.P.C. suggest that there is also a money dispute between the parties.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this court deems it fit t o release the applicant on bail.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one local solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
Date: 2023.08.18 18:15:17 +05'30' (ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE ps Ateesh Uikey vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
